subject: Unwanted extra space at top of legend

messages.author: d994cff5897faec8
messages.subject: Unwanted extra space at top of legend
parts:
In the example at the end of this message, the legend background
covers more space above the legend items than it does on the other
three sides. I assume this has something to do with leaving space for
the title, but since I have removed the legend title, I want that
extra space to go away. How do I do that? None of the options
settings seem to be what I want.

(This is simplified from a plot with the legend placed inside the plot
area; I'd like to get it so the legend items appear to be aligned to
the upper left-hand corner of the plot, but right now if I place it
appropriately, the legend background box overlaps the strip area.)

(Wouldn't it be nice if it were possible to place the legend relative
to a particular panel's plot area rather than to the overall page?)

zw

library(grid)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

dat <- melt(data.frame(x=1:20,
a=cumsum(rnorm(20)),
b=cumsum(runif(20)),
c=cumsum(rexp(20))),
id.vars='x')

ggplot(dat, aes(x=x, y=value, colour=variable)) +
geom_line() +
opts(legend.title=theme_blank(),
legend.key.height=unit(0.6,"lines"),
legend.background=theme_rect(colour="black"),
legend.margin=unit(0,"cm"))

I'm guessing that there is padding above and below the legend title
which is there even if the title is suppressed. That makes the padding
at the top seem bigger. One workaround is to move the title (and thus
its padding) to a different side where it may not look as bad:

You should file this as a bug report that the guides should not include
the extra padding between the title and the legend entries if there is
not a title.
